name: lf11_16_adjacency_merge
description: Conformance test 16. A 2x2 landfill zoned diagonally touching an existing 2x2 zone joins it: no new zone, the rect becomes the union (10, 10, 13, 13), the mask the 8 cells, and the heaps are rebuilt: W = H = 3, only heaps (0,0) and (2,2) have four mask cells, so c = round(240000 / 2) = 120000 each.
